name: orbit-hist-live-v2
notes: H-004, pre-declared before scoring. ONE change vs the v2 champion: estimator family GradientBoosting -> HistGradientBoosting with L2. Chosen only by host-grouped 5-fold CV on the train+val pool (759 rows), paired 95% interval on per-fold F1 against the champion excluded zero (+0.0215, [+0.0005, +0.0424]); the frozen test split was not read during selection. Same 12 catalog features, same seed, same validation-F1 threshold rule. Expect a marginal gain at best - the residual error is pixel-level blends.
